voiceover:
[conversational] Claude can't speak, but one connector gives it a realistic voice.

And stay till the end, because the real catch isn't the price. It's the license.

Paste your business story, and get a script plus a voice-over in one chat.

Step 1. Open Claude, go to Settings, or Customize, then Connectors.

Step 2. Search ElevenLabs, hit Connect, and sign in. No API key needed.

Step 3. In a new chat, open the plus menu, Connectors, and switch ElevenLabs on. Then paste your pitch and say:

"Turn this pitch into a short script, then a voice-over with an ElevenLabs voice."

[serious] Honest catch: the animation part isn't documented, so test it, and expect to edit the final cut. Free Claude has tight limits, so Pro at $20 a month is realistic.

[whispers] Now the license. ElevenLabs Free has no commercial license. For client or ad work, you need Starter, $6 a month.

Which video would you make first?

Send this to the friend who keeps paying for voice-overs.

Hack saved?

pick.topic: Connect ElevenLabs to Claude to turn a business story or product pitch into a script, a realistic voice-over and a finished animated explainer video, in 3 steps
pick.angle: Stop paying a freelancer $300 for a explainer video voice-over: Claude plus ElevenLabs does the script and the voice in minutes (and the catch: it needs a paid Claude plan)
pick.why: 27k views and 546 comments in 3 days, a high comment-to-view ratio driven by a 'comment CLAUDE for the guide' CTA. It's a specific, teachable workflow, and ElevenLabs' public pricing and voice pages show well on screen. It works for ads, product demos and onboarding videos, and we haven't covered it.

research.tool: ElevenLabs connector (hosted ElevenLabs MCP) in the Claude connectors directory
research.availability: The connector is free to add on every Claude plan, including Free. Claude Free has tight usage limits. Video and long narration need an ElevenLabs account with credits. ElevenLabs Free has no commercial license, and commercial use starts on the $6 Starter plan. Works on claude.ai, Claude Desktop and Claude Code, with separate EU/India/Singapore data-residency URLs.
steps: Open Claude (claude.ai or Claude Desktop) and go to Settings (ElevenLabs docs) or Customize (ElevenLabs MCP page and third-party guides) > Connectors. The label depends on the Claude app version.
Search for ElevenLabs in the directory and select Connect. You can also use the direct link https://claude.ai/directory/connectors/elevenlabs.
Sign in with your ElevenLabs account via OAuth. No API key is needed for the hosted connector.
In a new chat, make sure ElevenLabs is switched on for that chat (+ menu > Connectors).

Paste your business story or product pitch and ask Claude for a short script, a voice-over using an ElevenLabs voice, and an animated explainer. ElevenLabs says a single brief can produce a script, voiceover, music bed, sound design and video.
Claude returns the generated audio in the chat. Which animation or video tool it uses is not documented, so test it before filming.
facts: The ElevenLabs docs say the connector is listed in the Claude connector directory. The path they give is Settings > Connectors, then search ElevenLabs, select Connect and complete the OAuth sign-in.

The ElevenLabs MCP page gives a different path: Customize → Connectors. It also has an 'Add to Claude' button that pre-fills a custom connector named ElevenLabs with the URL https://api.elevenlabs.io/v1/mcp.
The hosted MCP server is at https://api.elevenlabs.io/v1/mcp and signs in with OAuth, so no API keys are copied into the client.

ElevenLabs describes the connector as managing voice and chat agents plus generating voice, music, images and video. It says it gives access to over 50 models, available in Claude, ChatGPT and Cursor.
The hosted MCP launched in Claude about 68 days before today, per the ElevenLabs blog. On August 17, 2026 ElevenLabs marked the older local open-source MCP as superseded by the hosted one.
Directory connectors are available to every Claude user, Free included (secondary sources citing Anthropic's help center). Free accounts are limited to one custom connector.
Claude pricing (Nov 2026, third-party roundups): Free $0, Pro $20/month ($17/month billed annually), Max $100/month, Ultra $200/month.

ElevenLabs pricing (Oct–Nov 2026, third-party): Free $0 with 10,000 credits, Starter $6 with 30,000 credits, Creator $22 with 121,000 credits ($11 first month promo), Pro $99, Scale $299, Business $990.
A Starter first month of $1 was being advertised in early November 2026. Annual billing means paying for 10 months to get 12.
The ElevenLabs Free plan has no commercial license and requires crediting 'elevenlabs.io' or '11.ai' in the title if you publish. Commercial rights start on Starter ($6).
Roughly 1 character = 1 credit, so 10,000 credits is about 10 minutes of speech (third-party).
Claude has no built-in text-to-speech. The voice comes from the ElevenLabs connector.
do_not_claim: Do not say the connector 'requires a paid Claude plan'. Directory connectors work on Claude Free. A paid plan is only practical because of usage limits. The reel's caption claim is not supported by Anthropic's documented connector rules.

Do not say Claude makes the finished animated video by itself. Claude writes the script, ElevenLabs makes the voice, and the animation depends on the 'master prompt' and tools. The reel's master prompt is not public, because it sits behind the 'comment CLAUDE' PDF. Verify it with a real test run before promising results.
Do not claim '3 steps' or 'ready in minutes' as a guarantee. Video generation and long narration can time out or burn credits.
Do not say the voice-over is free for business use. ElevenLabs Free has no commercial license.
Do not state '$300 freelancer' as a market fact. It is unverified, so present it as 'a typical quote' or leave it out.
Do not use the old setup (local server, API key, claude_desktop_config.json, uvx). That path is deprecated in favor of the hosted OAuth connector.
Do not say Claude needs ElevenLabs Starter or Creator just to connect. The connector itself works with an ElevenLabs Free account, within its credit limits.

Do not claim the connector is available in other assistants beyond what ElevenLabs lists. Its own FAQ says Claude and Claude Code today, 'more coming soon', while another ElevenLabs page also lists ChatGPT and Cursor.
criticism: Free ElevenLabs output has no commercial license, so a client or ad voice-over needs at least Starter ($6/month). Free-plan credits don't roll over.
Long-form narration quickly consumes credits, and some users report timeouts on lengthy operations (third-party review).
Claude Free has tight usage limits, so a script-plus-voice-plus-animation workflow may hit them fast.
The animated video part is not documented in detail by ElevenLabs or Anthropic. Results depend on the prompt and on how well the video models handle it.
The Claude app menu label differs between sources (Settings vs Customize), so the UI may differ by app version.
Generated audio is delivered as a file or in the chat, not a finished edited video. Expect to assemble or edit the final cut.

ui.platforms: Web (claude.ai) and Claude Desktop are the main paths. Directory connectors also work in the iOS/Android apps. The ElevenLabs sign-in page opens in a browser.
screens: I could not verify the exact current layout of Claude's screens. Treat the details below as approximate and check them in the live app.

Claude connectors screen: Settings or Customize, then the Connectors section. It has a Discover/directory view with search. Search 'ElevenLabs'. The ElevenLabs card has a 'Connect' button (some sources say 'Connect to Claude').
OAuth screen: you are sent to ElevenLabs to sign in and authorize the workspace, then return to Claude.
New chat: the '+' button near the message box opens a menu with 'Connectors'. Toggle ElevenLabs on there.

Result: Claude's reply contains the script as text and the generated voice-over as playable audio. Any video or animation shows as a file or link, or as an HTML/artifact animation, depending on the prompt.
Default theme is not verified. Record it in whichever mode your Claude app uses.

research.visuals: A real screen recording is the safest way to show it. Show the Connectors screen with ElevenLabs connected, the story pasted into the chat, the script on screen, the audio player with the voice-over, then the finished animation. The animation output itself must be recorded live, because its look and format are unverified.
notes: Angle check: the reel's 'Requires Claude paid plan' warning is partly wrong. The connector works on Free. The honest catch is Claude's usage limits and ElevenLabs credits plus its commercial-license rule. Suggested rewording: 'Free Claude can connect it, but a paid plan is realistic for the limits, and you need ElevenLabs Starter ($6) for commercial use'.

The cost comparison to a freelancer is legitimate: Claude Pro $20 plus ElevenLabs Starter $6 is roughly $26/month, against the $300 freelancer figure that the reel's topic assumes but nobody verified.
I could not open the transcript, the PDF or the reel's 'master prompt', so the animation method is unverified.

Real pages: elevenlabs.io/pricing and claude.com/pricing are known to exist, but I did not confirm their exact on-page text. The 'show' words for those two are best guesses, so check them live before recording. The text on elevenlabs.io/mcp and the blog page comes from search snippets, so also check it live.
The claude.ai directory link needs a login, so it is not suitable as a public page to record.
